ai.title: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
ai.brief: Letting people easily alter images with an AI prompt was a bad idea. Letting people easily alter images with an AI prompt was a bad idea. Google has shut down Google Earth feature it launched Thursday that allowed users to edit satellite images with text prompts using AI. The tool essentially let users create AI deepfakes of the real world using text prompts; Digital Digging ’s Henk van Ess, for example, intentionally generated images adding things like refugees near the Mexican border and a bomb crater by a hospital in Gaza. ”

sec.title: Suspected Chinese-Speaking Hackers Target Central Asian Governments With OctLurk and SilkLurk
sec.brief: A Chinese-speaking threat actor is suspected to be behind a fresh wave of cyber attacks targeting government organizations mainly located in Central Asia, including Afghanistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, and the Syrian Arab Republic, since January 2025.
